source_doc.title: MACOM Technology Solutions Q3 FY2026 Earnings Call (2026-08-06) — CEO Stephen Daly on customer urgency from the indium phosphide DFB laser supply shortage
source_doc.permission_basis: 第三方逐字轉錄（The Motley Fool，免費無 paywall），保存有限逐字節錄與 canonical URL。非 issuer 官方發布：對『CEO 說了什麼』可用，要升 tier 1 須以 MACOM IR webcast replay 逐句核對後才改標。

sources.quote: Customers are coming to us with urgency due to the general supply shortage of indium phosphide DFB lasers.

claims.statement: MACOM's CEO stated that customers are approaching MACOM with urgency because of a general supply shortage of indium phosphide DFB lasers. This is a merchant-supplier account of demand pull caused by market-wide InP DFB laser scarcity, and is an independent origin_entity from Coherent's own statement that it does not sell indium phosphide lasers externally. The transcript does not state when additional MACOM DFB laser capacity comes online; any 'capacity not until end of 2027' figure circulating in secondary commentary is NOT supported by this call.
claims.disproof_condition: If MACOM subsequently reports that customer urgency has abated, that InP DFB laser supply has normalised, or if merchant laser suppliers publicly report excess InP DFB capacity, the shortage-driven demand-pull claim is invalidated. Check each quarterly earnings call; on trigger, review within 48 hours.
